judgments.reason: The bigP3BCI PhysioNet dataset (DOI 10.13026/0byy-ry86) is the source data of this Study E derivative, with the same authors and the same P300 speller data.
judgments.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in dataset conversion, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI Study E data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension paper for organizing EEG data, a standard used by this dataset's BIDS formatting, not a paper describing BigP3BCI Study E.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
